_comment_mqtt: MQTT broker for the door lock. 'lock'/'unlock' are published to topic jarvis/door. Use just an IP (port defaults to 1883) or ip:port.
_comment: THREE light states. entity_id must be the HA entity id (light.xxx), NOT the friendly name. To turn a bulb OFF use {"state":"off"}. For a solid color use rgb_color [R,G,B] 0-255 and brightness 0-255. effect must match the bulb's effect_list exactly. Optional: "then": {follow-up command} + "then_after": seconds schedules a second command for the same bulb.
_comment_scanning: IDLE / waiting to scan: bulbs 1-3 OFF, bulb 4 runs the 'Blue pulse' DIY Govee scene. Govee DIY scenes are a select entity (the DIY Scene dropdown), so we turn the bulb on and then pick the option — the option text must match the dropdown EXACTLY (it is 'Blue pulse', lowercase p).
_comment_accepted: ACCESS GRANTED: bulbs 1-3 Starry Sky for 10s then warm orange (2700K); bulb 4 green for 5s then OFF.
_comment_denied: ACCESS DENIED: bulbs 1-3 OFF; bulb 4 red for 5s then back to Blue pulse.
